name: telegram.stock_expiring

description.en: The daily expiring-lots message (W0a), v2 (W-PREP P7): on the venue's first stock movement of the day, stock.expiring lists every open lot within EXPIRY_WARN_DAYS (2) of its best-before date; v2 adds, whenever the forecast could be applied (forecast: ok), each row's `item` and `surplus` = the lot's quantity minus the kitchen forecast's raw use from today through its date (inclusive), the item's lots taken first-expiry-first. Rendered as '... · ⚠ won't be used in time: N g → use first / special' in the group's language (sq/en/uk/ru). `forecast` says 'ok', 'learning' (under 3 weeks: no surplus, never a guess) or why the history could not be read. Acceptance (tested in-memory): 1 kg expiring tomorrow, forecast 150 g/day = 300 g -> 700 g. v1 readers: every v1 field is unchanged.
description.uk: Щоденне повідомлення про партії, що спливають, тепер каже, скільки не встигнуть використати за прогнозом кухні (1 кг завтра, прогноз 300 г -> 700 г).

auth.where: MISSING: operator creates a TEST bot + group (same ask as feature-stock-digest)

probe: node tools/live-proof/probes/prep-forecast.mjs --expiring (the read-back half needs the QA bot: NEEDS-KEY until then)
